en.name: Couscous
en.summary: Couscous is not a grain: it is tiny pasta, rolled from semolina, and it stores like dry pasta. Sealed in a cool, dark cupboard it keeps about 2 years. Cooked couscous is an entirely different proposition — a wet starch food that keeps 3–5 days refrigerated.
en.pantry: Keep dry couscous sealed in a cool, dark cupboard, where it runs about 2 years. Because it is dried semolina pasta rather than a whole grain, it is effectively stable in safety terms and limited instead by staling, damp and pantry insects. Wholemeal couscous is the exception: it carries the germ and its oil, so treat it like a wholemeal flour and use it well within a year rather than counting on the full span. Keep any of it away from the stove and out of the light.
en.fridge: Dry couscous does not belong in the fridge. The refrigerated figure here is for couscous that has been cooked: fluffed, cooled quickly and put into a sealed container at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, where it keeps 3–5 days. Cool it fast and spread out rather than leaving a covered bowl standing on the counter — cooked couscous is a moist starch, the same category as cooked rice and cooked pasta, and the same rule about not holding it warm applies. Reheat it until steaming hot.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for couscous. Dry couscous needs none — the cupboard already gives you two years — and freezing a sealed bag adds nothing beyond settling any weevil question in a bulk purchase. Cooked couscous can be frozen and will be safe indefinitely at −18 °C (0 °F), but no figure is published for it here, and it thaws softer and wetter than it went in, so the fridge window is the more useful number.
en.thawing: If you have frozen cooked couscous, reheat it straight from frozen with a splash of water until it is steaming hot, or thaw it overnight in the fridge. Never thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: A musty or damp smell in the dry grains, or clumps that will not break up.
Webbing, small moths or fine dust in the packet.
A bitter, paint-like smell from wholemeal couscous, which means the germ oil has turned.
Cooked couscous that smells sour or has gone slimy or ropy.
tips: Decant the packet into an airtight jar; the paper box is not a storage container.
Buy wholemeal couscous in small quantities and use it sooner than white.
Cool cooked couscous spread out on a tray, then box it and chill it.
Fluff cooked couscous with a fork before chilling so it does not set into a block.

faq.q: How long does dry couscous keep?
faq.a: About 2 years sealed in a cool, dark cupboard. It is semolina pasta, so it keeps like dry pasta.

faq.q: How long does cooked couscous keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a sealed container, if it was cooled quickly.
No. It is pasta rolled from semolina, which is why it stores far better than a whole grain does.

zh.name: 北非小米
aliases: 以色列大顆粒庫斯庫斯
zh.summary: 北非小米其實不是穀物：它是用杜蘭小麥粉搓成的極小顆粒麵食，保存方式跟乾燥義大利麵一樣。密封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 2 年。煮過的則完全是另一回事——那是含水的澱粉食品，冷藏 3～5 天。
zh.pantry: 乾燥的北非小米密封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃，約 2 年。因為它是乾燥的粗粒小麥麵食而不是全穀，在安全層面上基本穩定，真正限制它的是走味、受潮和櫥櫃害蟲。全麥版本是例外：它帶著胚芽和油脂，請比照全麥麵粉，在一年之內就用完，不要把期限算滿。不論哪一種，都要遠離爐火與光線。
zh.fridge: 乾燥的北非小米不該放冰箱。這裡的冷藏數字指的是「煮過的」：撥鬆、快速降溫後裝密封盒放 4 °C 以下，可放 3～5 天。請攤開快速降溫，不要蓋著碗放在檯面上——煮過的北非小米是含水澱粉，和熟飯、熟麵屬於同一類，「不要溫溫地放著」這條規則同樣適用。復熱要熱到冒蒸氣。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給北非小米的冷凍期限。乾燥的根本不需要——櫥櫃已經有兩年——把密封袋冷凍除了解決大量採購的蟲卵問題外，沒有額外好處。煮過的可以冷凍，−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，但本頁沒有對應數字，而且解凍後會比冷凍前更軟更濕，所以冷藏那個數字實用得多。
zh.thawing: 若冷凍了煮過的北非小米，請直接從冷凍加一點水復熱到冒蒸氣，或放冷藏隔夜解凍。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 乾燥顆粒聞起來有潮霉味，或結塊撥不開。
包裝內有絲網、小蛾或細粉屑。
全麥版本聞到苦味或油漆味，代表胚芽油脂變質。
煮過的聞起來發酸，或變得黏滑牽絲。
tips: 整包倒進密封罐；紙盒不是保存容器。
全麥版本少量買、比白色版本更早用完。
煮好的攤在淺盤上降溫，再裝盒冷藏。
冷藏前先用叉子撥鬆，才不會結成一整塊。

faq.q: 乾燥北非小米可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 2 年。它是杜蘭麵食，保存方式跟乾麵一樣。

faq.q: 煮過的北非小米冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 快速降溫後裝密封盒放 4 °C 以下，3～5 天。
不算。它是用粗粒小麥粉搓成的麵食，所以比全穀耐放得多。
